Steam._comment: Server-side Steam Web API key (steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey). Set via env Steam__ApiKey / STEAM_API_KEY in docker-compose. Users never enter keys.

Web._comment: Origin of the web frontend — used for CORS (with credentials) and post-login redirects.

DataProtection._comment: Optional dir for cookie-signing keys; set it (a mounted volume in Docker) so sessions survive restarts.
